question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Wheat, Rice, Grain

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8755a1ed50abee3253b7b40fcf2492e6fbb801905c9159d8fff044666a67269a.png]
solution:
The relationship between Wheat, Rice and Grain is as follows:

 
• All wheat are grain.
 
• All Rice are grain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b821df9f6c2ce265ecc97039b471ccafa88a55d9ea076ca1227ec369572181a.png]
